title: Prefix shadow probe for cache elasticity and token-latency accounting
creator: Amelia Park
description: Implement a lightweight "prefix-shadow" probe that synthesizes short, production-like requests to measure marginal per-token latency and the elasticity of the prefix/KV cache under live traffic. The probe attaches to the serving runtime as a tracing hook and emits structured metrics for: 1) token-level latency deltas when a cached prefix is hit vs missed, 2) KV cache occupancy and evictions correlated with request cohorts, and 3) observed fallback rates when fast paths are unavailable. The goal is to provide reproducible marginal measurements without impacting customer SLAs and to feed an attribution pipeline that maps per-token latency to cost-adjusted billing metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Probe runs in prod on a sampled subset (configurable) without adding more than 0.5% tail latency to user requests
Traces include spans named probe.prefix_shadow and probe.token_delta with per-token microsecond timings exported to the tracing pipeline
New metrics ingested into the metrics pipeline: redwood.infer.prefix_shadow.token_latency_us, redwood.infer.prefix_shadow.kv_miss_delta, redwood.infer.prefix_shadow.eviction_count
Dashboards: a token-latency heatmap by sequence slot and a cache-elasticity panel showing marginal latency vs cache occupancy are available in Grafana
A small downstream job computes token-cost attribution and publishes a reconciliation CSV for billing backfill
technical_notes: Probe design: shadow requests reuse request metadata but run asynchronously on spare threads/containers; runtime will tag probe spans with trace sampling flag probe:true
Sampling: default 0.25% of incoming TrafficClass=hosted-write; sampling tunable via remote config (console). Will ramp 0.25% -> 0.5% depending on observed noise
Tracing: use existing OpenTelemetry SDK. Add two short-lived spans per token: probe.token_prefetch and probe.token_emit_delta. Aggregate per-request before export to avoid trace explosion
Metrics: emit histogram of token_latency_us with explicit buckets (0-50us, 50-200us, 200-1000us, 1ms+). Emit gauge for kv_cache_age and eviction_count tagged by cache_shard
Storage: traces go to the instrumented-traces pipeline; metrics to Prometheus remote-write -> Cortex. Retention for probe samples is 30d (configurable)
Runtime hook: small API surface: register_prefix_shadow(config) -> returns probe_handle. Probe must be safe to enable in Dedicated/Private customers but disabled by default in air-gapped installs
Overhead: end-to-end probe walltime budget 5ms per probe (we must ensure probes are low-cost). Use quantized timers to minimize allocation churn
decisions: Will implement probe as asynchronous shadow requests rather than inlined instrumented code to reduce interference with production latency measurements
Will aggregate per-token spans into a single request-level summary object to limit trace volume and simplify downstream grouping
Will tag probe traces with 'probe=true' so downstream pipelines can filter and not affect SLO dashboards
blockers: Need runtime API changes in kernel scheduler to expose a safe prefetch hook (blocked on ENG-821345 merge)
Telemetry pipeline work to accept new histogram metric schema (work tracked in ENG-214256)
Confirm legal/QA for running synthetic probes in certain customers (privacy checklist)

notes: This probe focuses on marginal/lift measurements — it intentionally does not attempt to reconstruct absolute per-customer billing (that's handled by a downstream reconciliation job)
We should avoid naming metric labels with high cardinality (no raw prompt ids or user ids); use cohort tags (model, region, shard)
If probe introduces noise to SRE alerts, we will filter probe traces/metrics from SLO dashboards using the probe=true tag
